answer: Pay standing as compounding dividends: an identity's share of work grows the longer it behaves, reaching its zenith only after many epochs of verified delivery, so a fresh fake earns almost nothing. Any proven fraud forfeits every accrued dividend and resets the identity to zero — no echo of past standing survives. A jetty of new identities must therefore wait out the whole slow climb per fake, while a farm's parallel identities each pay the same waiting cost and risk losing everything at once.
